title: ficus heterophylla f. repens
intro: Ficus heterophylla f. repens, commonly known as the creeping fig, is a tropical evergreen plant species that belongs to the family Moraceae. It is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
